name: ComplianceCow MCP Server
description: Enables AI agents to interact with the ComplianceCow platform to retrieve compliance insights, dashboard data, and auditable evidence through a Compliance Graph. It also supports automated remediation actions such as fixing policies and creating tickets in external tools.

rawRecord.description: Enables AI agents to interact with the ComplianceCow platform to retrieve compliance insights, dashboard data, and auditable evidence through a Compliance Graph. It also supports automated remediation actions such as fixing policies and creating tickets in external tools.

CCOW_HOST.description: The hostname of the ComplianceCow instance (e.g., 'https://partner.compliancecow.live').

CCOW_CLIENT_ID.description: Your OAuth 2.0 client ID. Obtain this by clicking on 'Manage Client Credentials' in the top-right user profile menu of your ComplianceCow instance.

CCOW_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Your OAuth 2.0 client secret. Obtain this by clicking on 'Manage Client Credentials' in the top-right user profile menu of your ComplianceCow instance.
